boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Endicott College rituals spanning the opening of the academic year, Commencement, nursing recognition, and Homecoming.

cards.title: Begin the Year at Convocation
cards.subtitle: The annual ceremonial welcome for new and returning Gulls
cards.notes: Join the campus-wide welcome, listen for the year’s academic theme, and watch the incoming class begin its Endicott chapter.
cards.short_summary: Endicott opens each academic year by gathering the community for a formal welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies Convocation as an annual tradition marking the academic year’s start; the 2025 ceremony was required for new students and open to everyone.
cards.access_notes: New students were required to attend in 2025, while the wider Endicott community was invited.

cards.title: Stay for Dinner Around the Lakes
cards.subtitle: The outdoor meal that follows Endicott’s Convocation ceremony
cards.notes: After Convocation, follow the community toward the lakes for the shared dinner that completes Endicott’s opening-day tradition.
cards.short_summary: A lakeside community dinner extends Convocation beyond the formal ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott’s official News & Events page states that Convocation includes a ceremony followed by dinner around the lakes.
cards.access_notes: Held in connection with Convocation; participation details may vary by academic year.

cards.title: Hear the Alma Mater Open the Year
cards.subtitle: A young college song embedded in Endicott ceremonies
cards.notes: Listen for the Endicott Singers at Convocation; their performance of the alma mater formally closes the opening ceremony.
cards.short_summary: Endicott’s alma mater, composed in 2020–21, now helps mark the academic year’s ceremonial opening.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott says its alma mater was composed in 2020–21, and reports that the Endicott Singers performed it at the 2025 Convocation.
cards.access_notes: Performed during ceremonial programs; attendance follows the access rules for the host event.

cards.title: Pass the Stole to Your Supporter
cards.subtitle: Commencement gratitude worn first, then given away
cards.notes: Wear the stole during Commencement, then present it afterward to a parent, relative, mentor, or another person who supported you.
cards.short_summary: Graduates turn part of their ceremony attire into a direct thank-you after Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott instructs graduates to wear the Stole of Gratitude during Commencement and afterward present it to someone who offered extraordinary support.
cards.access_notes: Intended for participating graduates; the official page says stoles are sold through the bookstore.

cards.title: Follow the Bagpipes into Commencement
cards.subtitle: Campbell Highlanders have led Endicott’s procession since 2012
cards.notes: Arrive before the procession and listen for the Campbell Highlanders, whose bagpipes announce the graduating class’s ceremonial entrance.
cards.short_summary: A bagpipe-led procession has opened Endicott Commencement ceremonies for more than a decade.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott introduced bagpipers at Commencement in 2012 and states that the Campbell Highlanders have led the procession every year since.
cards.access_notes: Visible to Commencement participants and admitted guests during the formal procession.

cards.title: Decode the Seal on the Diploma
cards.subtitle: Lions, circles, a ship, quill, book, and map carry Endicott symbolism
cards.notes: Look closely at the Commencement program or degree and identify the seal’s ship, lion, circles, quill, book, and world map.
cards.short_summary: Endicott places a symbol-rich institutional seal on both its Commencement program and every graduate’s degree.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott states that its College Seal appears on the Commencement program and every graduate’s degree and explains the meaning of its individual symbols.
cards.access_notes: The seal can be viewed on official Commencement programs and graduates’ degrees.

cards.title: Read the Colors in the Graduation Crowd
cards.subtitle: Endicott programs and disciplines signal achievement through distinctive regalia
cards.notes: At Commencement, spot green Endicott Scholars stoles, blue Leadership Scholars stoles, and the discipline-specific cords listed by the College.
cards.short_summary: Endicott’s graduation attire turns academic affiliations into a visible field of program-specific colors.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott documents green stoles for Endicott Scholars, blue stoles for Leadership Scholars, and designated cords or medallions for honor groups and disciplines.
cards.access_notes: Regalia is reserved for graduates who earned the corresponding academic or organizational distinction.

cards.title: Pause for Senior Awards Before Commencement
cards.subtitle: Baccalaureate recognition for Endicott’s graduating students
cards.notes: Attend the Baccalaureate ceremony to see seniors recognized for campus leadership, scholarship, athletics, and thesis or capstone work.
cards.short_summary: Endicott formally recognizes graduating students in a dedicated ceremony immediately before Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott calls Senior Awards a College tradition and presents categories including Campus Leadership, Scholar Athlete, Dean’s, and Capstone and Thesis awards.
cards.access_notes: The undergraduate ceremony welcomes students; families of award nominees are notified separately.

cards.title: Receive the Nursing Pin Before Graduation
cards.subtitle: A professional welcome for Endicott’s undergraduate nursing graduates
cards.notes: If invited, watch each undergraduate nursing graduate receive a pin marking the transition from Endicott student to nursing professional.
cards.short_summary: Endicott’s nursing graduates are individually pinned during the celebrations preceding Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott describes Nurse Pinning as a meaningful tradition and schedules a special ceremony in which undergraduate nursing students receive their nursing pins.
cards.source_title: A Great Day to be a Gull
cards.access_notes: The College’s current ceremonies page identifies the nursing pinning ceremony as invitation-only.

cards.title: Crack a Lobster at Homecoming
cards.subtitle: A North Shore meal shared by students, families, and alumni
cards.notes: Reserve the lobster option during Homecoming and join students, families, and returning alumni for Endicott’s communal North Shore dinner.
cards.short_summary: The Homecoming table brings generations of Gulls together over a traditional lobster dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott’s 2025 Homecoming recap calls its lobster dinner a beloved tradition shared by parents, students, and alumni.
cards.access_notes: A Homecoming event with separate registration or ticketing; current event details should be checked before attending.
